trends.rule: auto-add a niche when 12-month Wikipedia views ≥ 500/mo and YoY ≥ 0% (Wikipedia overall fell ~20% YoY, so flat = relative growth). Blocked if trademark.

niche_method: Score = sqrt(views / top views in its category) x season ratio (last-year views for the coming 3 months / 12-month average, capped 0.5-3) x category weight (pets 0.6, others 1). Our heuristic, labeled. Wikipedia pageviews = public interest proxy, NOT sales. Keyword volumes shown are third-party ESTIMATES with links.

competitors.note: Competitor price benchmarks from public, ToS-compliant sources (articles/keyword-tool pages read without login; no Etsy scraping). Ranges are what the SOURCE reports; treat as ESTIMATES. Reviewed by hand; the daily Action flags entries older than 60 days.

benchmarks.claim: Watercolor breed canvas $55–85 (base $22–30); highest-AOV standard POD pet item.
Mid tier $40–80 dominates canvas/framed portraits (Crown & Paw, West & Willow).
Entry tier $15–40 covers digital/small prints; listadum median pet-listing price ~$14.95; rankhero 'personalized pet portrait' typical ~$19.99.
